thread:
anya: Quick callout 7: we need a compact v1 playbook for Dedicated fallback behavior tied to headroom tiers. Sales keeps asking for 'guaranteed' latency but we can't promise unlimited headroom. Can we land on a default that is easy to explain?

mike: TL;DR proposal: conservative default headroom -> soft shared buffer -> model-slimming quant only after buffer. Make ordering tenant-configurable; default should favor paid prewarm when present.

sunil: Ops: +1 for conservative. Also require a circuit-breaker so if a tenant hits fallback >1% of requests in 5m we auto-disable fallback for them and page SRE.

greta: Customers expect clear billing/limits. Recommend we surface a "headroom allowance" in Console (tokens/min) and a visible "fallback used" indicator during incidents.

rachel: From compliance: audit trail per fallback event is mandatory for enterprise deals. Append immutable log record with reason and path.

anya: Acceptance checklist suggestion:
- tenant-level ordering configurable in Console (simple dropdown)
- default ordering: prewarm -> shared headroom -> quant-downscale
- fallback_event telemetry with tenant_id, path, added_latency_ms, tokens
- automatic local disable if fallback_rate > 1% for SLA tenants (5m)
- audit log entry per fallback

mike: Runtime notes: mapping table for quant variants + per-tenant metadata for ordering. Shared headroom needs admission control and per-tenant soft quotas. Canary flag required.

sunil: Monitoring: dashboard tiles for headroom utilization, fallback rate per tenant, and a canary alert rule. Runbook: how to flip off fallback per tenant and how to throttle shared headroom.

greta: UX: show projected "remaining headroom" for the rolling hour and an opt-out toggle labelled "latency guarantee (disable fallbacks)". Also an explanation tooltip for billing.

ops-bot: NOTE: feature flag created: feature.dedicated.headroom_fallback_v1. Use for canary rollout.

anya: Risks + mitigations quick:
- silent quality loss from quant: mitigation -> require model-owner opt-in for automatic quant at GA, pilot-only opt-in for now.
- customer surprise billing: mitigation -> preview export for pilots + clear invoice line items for fallback usage.
- noisy alarms: mitigation -> conservative defaults and a small canary cohort first.

mike: Rough timeline: mapping + telemetry = 2 sprints; headroom admission + quotas = 1 sprint; Console UI + billing preview = 1 sprint parallel. Canary 1-2 weeks.

sunil: Ops block: alerts + runbook must be in place before canary.

greta: Product note: make the Console copy explicit: "Projected vs Actual" for charges.

anya: Action items:
- mike: runtime spec + mapping example (due Fri)
- sunil: alert defs + runbook + dashboard mock (due Tue)
- greta: Console copy + billing preview copy (due Tue)
- rachel: audit log format + retention notes (due Wed)
- anya: recruit 3 pilot tenants and coordinate canary (due Mon)

mike: I'll drop the mapping WIP in #eng-runtime later today.

sunil: Adding runbook PR to the list; will ping once alerts are ready.

greta: I'll work with sales to identify pilot tenants who consent to dry-run billing.

anya: If no objections I'm locking this v1 scope to the roadmap card. We can iterate on cross-region and instance-type fallbacks in v2. :thumbsup:

mike: LGTM.

sunil: Ops OK, blocking canary until alerts wired.

greta: Product OK.

rachel: Compliance OK with audit log requirement.

anya: Thanks all. Filing tickets and follow-ups in #eng-runtime and #console.
